method: Each normative LLD-02 acceptance scenario is bound to current production owner paths and named executable behavior. Marker/name presence is not treated as semantic proof. Partial or LLD-08-owned clauses remain explicit rather than being inferred from adjacent tests.
certification_rule: Certification requires every non-deferred LLD-02 clause to have inspectable semantic evidence and the exact final implementation head to pass the supported implementation CI matrix, release-schema gate, design pin, wheel build and packaged authority-resource verification.
known_limits: LLD-08 Site persistence/lifecycle is not started; Site-owned clauses are explicitly deferred or partial.
Consumer-owned historical snapshots are not reclassified as LLD-02-owned merely because reference history is preserved.
The mechanical acceptance-marker report is report-only and cannot promote partial cases.

prove: rename Customer/Contact/Dispatch Location leaves UUID unchanged
dependent relationships still resolve immutable ID
cases.note: Customer, Contact and Dispatch descriptive renames preserve immutable IDs; the current Contact affiliation continues to resolve the same Contact and Customer IDs after both masters are renamed.

prove: two active Contacts may share exact name
two Customer Organizations may share exact normalized name
no uniqueness constraint or silent merge fires
cases.note: Duplicate names remain distinct immutable identities; no merge/uniqueness authority is introduced.

prove: UNICODE_MATCH_V1 performs Unicode-17 NFKC, Unicode whitespace collapse and full case folding
accents preserved
punctuation preserved
Python 3.13 and 3.14 produce byte-identical accepted keys
runtime built-in Unicode version cannot change results
cases.note: Pinned Unicode-17 asset drives deterministic matching rather than host Unicode tables.

prove: reference_metadata contains UNICODE_MATCH_V1
unsupported stored profile blocks matching reads/writes
future profile change requires migration/reindex rather than opportunistic rewrite
cases.note: Persisted matching-profile mismatch fails closed on reads and writes.

prove: Customer Account Code remains separate from customer_org_id
one code claimant outranks compatible name-only evidence
code-vs-different-name candidate returns AMBIGUOUS
name alone never assigns code
cases.note: Account-code evidence remains separate from customer identity and ambiguity is preserved.

prove: ordinary SetCustomerAccountCode detects another claimant and performs no mutation
ConfirmCustomerAccountCodeSharedClaim can explicitly add reviewed second claimant
subsequent matching returns AMBIGUOUS over every eligible active claimant
no Customer merge occurs
cases.note: Unreviewed stealing is blocked; reviewed shared claims remain explicitly ambiguous.

prove: reviewed reassignment supersedes source claim and creates target claim atomically
third-party shared claimants are not silently changed
creation/supersession command identities/timestamps remain queryable
historical Customer context elsewhere is unchanged
cases.note: Reviewed reassignment preserves superseded claim history.

prove: same normalized email under different Customer affiliations is not global collision
same email within requested scope may yield multiple candidates and AMBIGUOUS
UNBOUND scope searches only currently unbound Contacts
cases.note: Email matching is affiliation-scoped; UNBOUND and ambiguity semantics are explicit.

prove: UNRESOLVED/UNIQUE_CANDIDATE/AMBIGUOUS queries create no rows/audit/lifecycle events
unique candidate does not itself merge/link/assign external identifier
cases.note: Matching queries are read-only and do not assign identity.

prove: candidate_count represents full result
page max cannot turn AMBIGUOUS into UNIQUE_CANDIDATE
opaque continuation yields stable immutable-ID ordering
cases.note: Full candidate state is independent of visible page size and continuations are stable.

prove: Contact starts unbound or with one current affiliation
change closes prior row and inserts new current row atomically
contact_id never changes
dual-current state impossible
cases.note: Affiliation transition closes prior history and preserves one current row.

prove: closure records closing command identity
closed affiliation cannot be edited/deleted by ordinary runtime
only current-to-historical closure transition accepted by SQLite protection
cases.note: Closed affiliation history is protected by schema triggers and carries closure command identity.

prove: later Contact affiliation change does not rewrite organization-at-use snapshots stored by consumers
historical affiliation rows remain queryable
cases.note: LLD-02 history remains queryable, but consumer-owned organization-at-use snapshot immutability requires explicit cross-packet evidence binding.

prove: Contact can be created with zero channels
missing channel does not block unrelated Ticket/Task/Objective/Inventory operations
recipient-requiring workflow reports prerequisite only at use time
cases.note: Zero-channel Contact and use-time channel prerequisite behavior are proven locally; unrelated Ticket/Task/Objective/Inventory operation independence is not yet bound here.

prove: EMAIL_CHANNEL_V1 accepts governed one-addr-spec syntax and rejects malformed/control/CRLF values
validation performs no DNS/SMTP/network request
active valid specific channel can return USABLE
generated-artifact owner snapshots exact address separately
cases.note: Storage/use validation is proven; generated-artifact owner snapshotting of the exact address remains consumer-owned evidence.

prove: add/update/archive increments Contact aggregate revision
archived channel no longer matches or qualifies as recipient
generated historical recipient snapshots remain unchanged
stale Contact/channel revisions block overwrite
cases.note: Channel revision/history/stale-edit semantics are proven; historical generated-recipient snapshot immutability remains consumer-owned evidence.

prove: registered active dependencies block archive
write-path guard performs no unbounded blocker materialization
no lifecycle state/event/audit/receipt commits when blocked
cases.note: Real Inventory requester/Fault Tag dependencies block archive atomically through the registered validator.

prove: read-only preview computes exact blocker count across validators
bounded pages/continuation preserve deterministic order
would_be_eligible depends on exact count not visible page
preview creates no mutation
cases.note: Preview exact count, deterministic bounded paging and read purity are directly exercised.

prove: Site-dedicated/logistics guards block unauthorized archive
no automatic Site/logistics unlinking occurs
separate reviewed Site lifecycle authority remains required where applicable
cases.note: LLD-07 logistics/Fault Tag guards are real and fail closed; Site-dedicated lifecycle authority remains an LLD-08 obligation and is intentionally not fabricated pre-LLD08.

prove: explicit reactivation preserves archived history
new conflict/indeterminate guard blocks reactivation atomically
active selectors include record only after commit
cases.note: Reactivation preserves archive history and exact replay.

prove: dispatch_locations has no Customer ownership/preference field
same active location can participate in otherwise valid roles without master ownership change
operation role remains on consumer
cases.note: Dispatch master has no Customer ownership field; role remains consumer-owned.

prove: LLD-08 coordinator creates site-derived Dispatch Location and Site relation in same UoW
failure inserting Site/relation rolls back location/evidence/receipt
one-to-one constraints belong to LLD-08
cases.note: The LLD-02 shared-UoW participant and rollback seam are proven. Actual Site relation/one-to-one coordination belongs to LLD-08, which has not started.

prove: site-derived location stores no standalone address
current address comes through SiteDispatchAddressProvider
later Site address change does not rewrite prior LLD-07 logistics snapshots
cases.note: No standalone address is stored and current address crosses SiteDispatchAddressProvider; live Site-change versus prior LLD-07 logistics snapshot evidence awaits LLD-08 integration.

prove: first-run creates one metadata identity
second singleton insert fails
Contact cannot be login identity
no verifier/password/key material exists in LLD-02 tables
cases.note: Singleton descriptive identity is separate from credential/session authority.

prove: absent known setting returns DEFAULT with no row creation
unknown key rejected
read produces no audit/receipt/default persistence
cases.note: Known defaults are read-pure; unknown keys fail and reads do not persist defaults.

prove: strict JSON/state-independent checks occur before writer lock
bounded state-dependent checks rerun inside UoW
stale revision blocks write
failed upgrade preserves prior value
successful write commits value+receipt+audit atomically
cases.note: Typed validation, stale-safe atomic write and exact replay are bound.

prove: password/verifier/key/token/device-credential definitions cannot register in ordinary setting store
unsafe JSON never falls back to generic serialization
cases.note: Secret-bearing definition classes are excluded from the ordinary setting store.

prove: accepted create/archive/reactivate/correction lifecycle events reject update/delete
master delete guards reject ordinary hard delete
required audit references resulting lifecycle identity
audit failure rolls back mutation/event
cases.note: Lifecycle history is append-only and an injected audit failure after attempted archive mutation rolls back receipt, master state, lifecycle event and audit evidence atomically.

prove: two editors use same base revision
first commit increments revision
second gets STALE_REVISION and cannot overwrite first
cases.note: Two editors starting from the same descriptive reference revision are exercised directly; the second receives STALE_REVISION and cannot overwrite the first commit.

prove: registry calls explicit domain validators using same UoW
LLD-02 contains no direct SQL against Tickets/Inventory/Infrastructure/Communications private tables
indeterminate validator fails closed
cases.note: Registry is finalized explicitly, uses injected provider interfaces and fails closed on indeterminate results.

prove: each governed field uses field-specific byte/line bound
overflow rejects before normalization/parser blow-up
no value is truncated
there is no universal 400-character or total-record product cap
cases.note: Field-specific bounds reject before expensive normalization/parsing and never truncate.

prove: ordinary list/history/channel/candidate pages use keyset cursors and supporting indexes
Contact page projection is set-based rather than N+1
archive write guards use indexed existence queries
full blocker enumeration occurs outside BEGIN IMMEDIATE
cases.note: Contact detail performs a fixed five-SELECT set-based projection for both zero and 25 channels; list/channel/affiliation-history plans use their declared supporting indexes without temp sorting.

prove: generic reference_type accepts only closed enum
cursor/sort/type input never becomes raw SQL identifier/text
all values use bound parameters
no DELETE route exists for history-bearing reference records
cases.note: Transport is closed, owner-injected and contains no SQL/persistence authority or delete route.

prove: freshly setting same Account Code/name/channel/affiliation/descriptive state/setting produces committed NO_CHANGE receipt
no revision/lifecycle/relationship/audit row is fabricated
lost-response retry with same command_id/hash remains NO_CHANGE after later state changes
different hash with same command_id fails integrity
cases.note: Fresh same-state commands across all governed LLD-02 mutation families commit exact NO_CHANGE receipts/results without fabricated owner/history/audit mutation; replay remains exact after later state change and changed-hash reuse conflicts.

prove: review preview returns server-derived review_snapshot_hash bound to matching profile, customer_reference_generation, exact claimant count, target/source IDs/revisions/current claims and proposed action
claim/reference change before commit increments generation and yields REVIEW_CONTEXT_STALE
commit validation uses O(1) metadata/point work plus indexed COUNT and never streams claimant detail under writer lock
cases.note: Review freshness is generation-bound; commit validation is instrumented inside the writer transaction to require bounded metadata/point/COUNT work with no claimant-detail stream, and COUNT/point plans use the declared indexes.

prove: AUTO_SELECT with one usable email returns USABLE
AUTO_SELECT with more than one usable email returns MULTIPLE_USABLE + exact count/bounded IDs
SQL row order never selects recipient
explicit selected channel can proceed if still active/valid
cases.note: AUTO_SELECT never depends on SQL row order; exact multiple-usable state is surfaced.

prove: every LLD-02 table is SQLite STRICT
direct insert of non-email channel_kind fails DB constraint
LLD-01 schema verifier detects missing STRICT/index/protection/generation trigger drift
cases.note: STRICT, closed channel-kind, supporting-index and protection-trigger drift are release-schema verified.
